attachment.fromDisk: Read from {{path}} when the request is sent
attachment.tooLarge: {{name}} is {{size}}. The web app sends files up to {{limit}}, because its hosted proxy accepts requests of at most {{proxyLimit}}. The desktop app sends files up to {{desktopLimit}} straight from disk.
attachment.proxyTooLarge: The request is larger than the {{proxyLimit}} the web app can pass through its proxy. Send large bodies and files from the desktop app or the CLI.
